concepts.title: Failure of diagonal-plus-strictly-singular decomposition on a Gowers-space subspace
concepts.description: There is a closed subspace Y of Gowers’s unconditional space X_U and a bounded operator T:Y→X_U which cannot be written D|Y+S with D a bounded diagonal operator on X_U and S strictly singular.

concepts.title: Gowers’s unconditional space from the hyperplane construction
concepts.description: The Banach space X_U from Gowers’s 1994 construction, obtained by completing c₀₀ in a norm combining Schlumprecht-type successive-coordinate averages and specially coded functionals using absolute coordinate data. Its unit vector basis is unconditional and tight by support; admissible coding data are fixed in the construction.

concepts.title: Existence of a greatest harmonic minorant on the unit disk
concepts.description: A superharmonic function on the unit disk that has a subharmonic minorant not identically−∞ has a greatest harmonic function lying below it.

concepts.title: Green function of the unit disk
concepts.description: For z,ζ in the disk, G(z,ζ)=log|(1−ζ̄z)/(z−ζ)|, with value∞ at z=ζ; it is zero at the boundary in the z variable and gives the disk’s logarithmic potential kernel.

concepts.title: Grüss inequality for finite families in semi-inner-product C*-modules
concepts.description: Let pᵢ≥0 sum to one, and let xᵢ,yᵢ lie in a semi-inner-product C*-module with ∥xᵢ−a∥≤r and ∥yᵢ−b∥≤s. Then ∥∑pᵢ⟨xᵢ,yᵢ⟩−⟨∑pᵢxᵢ,∑pᵢyᵢ⟩∥≤rs; the constant one is optimal.

concepts.title: Grüss inequality for bounded real functions
concepts.description: If m≤f≤M and n≤g≤N almost everywhere on [a,b], with a<b, then the absolute difference between the average of fg and the product of the averages of f and g is at most (M−m)(N−n)/4. The constant 1/4 is optimal.

concepts.title: Haar’s theorem for compact groups
concepts.description: Every compact Hausdorff topological group has a unique left-invariant regular Borel probability measure, and that measure is also right invariant.

concepts.title: Hardy space H∞ on the unit disk
concepts.description: The bounded holomorphic functions on the unit disk, with the supremum norm.

concepts.title: Hardy space H² on the unit disk
concepts.description: The holomorphic functions f(z)=∑ₙ≥0aₙzⁿ on the unit disk with ∑|aₙ|²<∞, normed by (∑|aₙ|²)¹ᐟ²; boundary values identify it with the nonnegative-frequency subspace of L² of the unit circle.

concepts.title: Boundary norm formula for Hardy H∞
concepts.description: For bounded holomorphic f on the disk, its radial boundary function f* exists almost everywhere and sup_D|f|=ess sup_T|f*|.

concepts.title: Hardy–Littlewood maximal function
concepts.description: For locally integrable f on ℝⁿ, Mf(x)=sup_{r>0}|B(x,r)|⁻¹∫_{B(x,r)}|f(y)|dy.

concepts.title: Hardy–Littlewood weak (1,1) maximal inequality
concepts.description: For integrable f on ℝⁿ and λ>0, the Lebesgue measure of {Mf>λ} is at most C_n∥f∥₁/λ, with a constant depending only on n.

concepts.title: Logarithmic boundary integrability of nonzero Hardy H² functions
concepts.description: A nonzero f∈H² has log|f*|∈L¹ on the unit circle, and log|f(0)|≤∫log|f*|dm when f(0)≠0, with m probability-normalized arc measure.

concepts.title: Harmonic function on a plane domain
concepts.description: A twice continuously differentiable real function u on an open Ω⊂ℝ² satisfying ∂₁²u+∂₂²u=0.

concepts.title: Harnack convergence theorem for monotone harmonic functions
concepts.description: An increasing sequence of positive harmonic functions on a connected domain either tends to∞ everywhere or converges uniformly on compact subsets to a harmonic function. A decreasing sequence bounded below by a harmonic function has a harmonic limit if finite at one point.

concepts.title: Continuity of mixed volume under Hausdorff convergence
concepts.description: If each sequence K_{i,j} of convex bodies converges in Hausdorff distance to K_i, then V(K_{1,j},…,K_{n,j})→V(K₁,…,K_n).

concepts.title: Continuity of projection volume under Hausdorff convergence
concepts.description: For a fixed linear subspace E, Hausdorff convergence of convex bodies K_j to K implies convergence of the Euclidean volumes of K_j|E to that of K|E.

concepts.title: Hausdorff distance between compact sets
concepts.description: For nonempty compact sets A,B in a metric space, d_H(A,B) is the maximum of sup_{a∈A}inf_{b∈B}d(a,b) and sup_{b∈B}inf_{a∈A}d(a,b).
